principal_reference.use: Principal appearance target; comparison only, no copied art or engine capability claim

comparison_regions.observation: Concept has compact articulated adventurer detail, separate boots, gloves, belt and cloak. Probe has independently colored face/hair/clothing/bracers/buckle/pouch/cape/sword; its larger, more angular proportions need approval.

Concept individual timber/barrel masses read beneath finer character accents despite a dense scene. Probe crate and faceted barrel deliberately use fewer divisions and materials; final surface richness is deferred.

Concept masonry/ground and plant contact provide layered depth. Probe corner and boots use real directional/local shadow contact. Baked AO, SSAO and final contact-depth are T08, not demonstrated here.

Concept combines warm amber pools with desaturated green/slate surroundings. Probe uses the same color relationships as an observation, with day/warm/cool captures; it lacks concept texture density and glow.

proposed_bounds.bound: At zoom x1, reviewer can distinguish head, torso, two boots and at least three of bracer/belt/pouch/cape/sword without zooming; a crate/barrel remains visibly simpler. Compare x2 only as a diagnostic.
Retain 384x216 and ortho 9/4.5 for this feasibility series. Accept the larger and more angular probe character only as a prototype deviation; production proportions require BW-098 review.
Character silhouette remains separable from paving/props in all three lighting states; boots contact the ground, corner depth is visible, amber light does not erase face/clothing separation.

T04/T09 must show no stationary pixel changes, no repeated crawl/shimmer on rigid edges during slow/diagonal tracking, no one-frame silhouette disappearance or outline-width pumping. One internal-pixel silhouette lines and selective convex highlights are reviewed in T05. No motion pass is claimed in T03.
No filled-surface outlines, stale reflection/depth frames, actor disappearance or unauthorized information in later combined cases; fallback deviations need explicit review.
